messages.welcomeAuthorized:
Hi! I can help you turn Telegram notes into Trello tasks ✨

Send one or more text messages, then press *Create task* when you are ready.
messages.welcomeUnauthorized:
Hi! I can help you turn Telegram notes into Trello tasks ✨

Connect Trello first to create tasks.
messages.tooShort: Still too little text: {{length}} characters. I need at least 15. Add more detail, then press *Create task* again.
messages.draftEmpty: I do not see any task text yet. Send task details, then press *Create task*.
messages.pickBoard: Great, now choose the board where the card should be created:
messages.noBoards: I could not find available boards for this Trello user.
messages.reuseSelection:
Board: *{{boardName}}*
List: *{{listName}}*

Create the card here?
messages.noLists: This board has no available lists yet. Let us choose another board.
messages.canceled: Ok, task canceled. The current draft was cleared, and you can send messages for the next task.
messages.boardChanged: Ok, let us choose another board.
messages.waitLastSelection: Choose one of the options below.
messages.waitBoard: First choose a board from the buttons below.
messages.waitList: First choose a list from the buttons below.
messages.cardInProgress: Got it! Building the card and sending it to Trello.
messages.readyForNextDraft: Ready for a new task. Send messages and press *Create task*.
messages.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
messages.unsupportedMessage: Only text messages are supported for now.
messages.authRequired: To continue, you need to connect Trello. This is required once every 30 days.
messages.authLinkCreated:
Open the link and confirm Trello access. Then return to Telegram and continue with the same draft.

Link valid until: *{{expiresAt}}*
messages.authDisconnected: Trello account disconnected. Connect Trello again to create tasks.
messages.authStatusExpired:
Trello connection expired ⚠️
User: *{{username}}*
Expired: *{{expiresAt}}*
Reconnect the account.
messages.authStatusNotConnected: Trello is not connected. Press *Connect Trello* to continue.
messages.authFlowInterrupted: The current Trello session is unavailable. Reconnect the account; your draft is preserved.
messages.authServiceSessionAlreadyUsed: This link has already been used. Return to Telegram and start Trello connection again.
messages.authServiceSessionExpired: Authorization session expired. Start connection again.
messages.authServiceSessionStatusInvalid: Invalid session status. Start connection again.
messages.authServiceMissingCallbackParams: Trello callback is missing required parameters.
messages.authServiceTokenMismatch: Session token does not match. Start connection again.
messages.authServiceConnected: Trello connected. You can return to Telegram.
messages.authServiceConnectedNotification: Trello connected. You can create a task ✅
messages.timeZoneSetupIntro: To understand task deadlines correctly, set your time zone in the settings app. You can skip this; I will use the default value.

authPage.fallbackResultMessage: An error occurred. Return to Telegram and try again.
authPage.appNotBuilt: The app has not been built yet. Run npm run build.
authPage.returnHint: Return to the Telegram bot and continue.
